task.objective: Prove that the full column coordinate word determines a BridgePath with the fixed source, eliminating horizontal-realization multiplicity from a future exact transfer encoding. This is an independently checkable structural sublemma; it does not prove any count, finite-box bound, transfer identity, or summability and does not close strip_growth_below_mu or the original target.
task.type: ∀ {h : ℕ} {p q : OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.BridgePath h}, p.vertices.map (fun v : OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.Vertex => match v with | .up i j => 2 * i + j | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1) = q.vertices.map (fun v : OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.Vertex => match v with | .up i j => 2 * i + j | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1) → p = q

task.objective: Prove local uniqueness of an adjacent successor with a given full column code. This is an independently checkable atomic case analysis; it is strictly smaller than full-column-word injectivity and proves no count, finite-box bound, transfer identity, or summability.
task.type: ∀ {a b d : OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.Vertex}, OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.adjacent a b → OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.adjacent a d → (match b with | .up i j => 2 * i + j | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1) = (match d with | .up i j => 2 * i + j | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1) → b = d
